name: basecraft
description: Desktop database application in the spirit of Microsoft Access
author: SARL IN SET <info@in-set.com>

linux.synopsis: Desktop database application in the spirit of Microsoft Access
linux.description: Tables, queries, forms, reports and macros, in a single .basecraft file that is an ordinary SQLite database.

entry.Name: BaseCraft
entry.Comment[fr]: Tables, requêtes, formulaires, états et macros, dans un seul fichier .basecraft qui est une base SQLite ordinaire.

scripts.dist:win: electron-vite build && npm run licenses && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:signed: electron-vite build && npm run licenses && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.sign.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: electron-vite build && npm run licenses && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: electron-vite build && npm run licenses && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:runtime:win: electron-vite build --mode runtime && npm run licenses && electron-builder --config electron-builder.runtime.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:runtime:win:signed: electron-vite build --mode runtime && npm run licenses && electron-builder --config electron-builder.runtime.sign.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:runtime:linux: electron-vite build --mode runtime && npm run licenses && electron-builder --config electron-builder.runtime.cjs --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.e2e: electron-vite build && electron-vite build --mode runtime && playwright test
